metricHints.totalROI: Return on Investment — total profit relative to total cost

metricHints.cashOnCash: Annual pre-tax cash flow divided by total cash invested
metricHints.annualNOI: Net Operating Income — revenue minus operating expenses, before debt service
metricHints.grossRentMultiplier: Purchase price divided by gross annual rent — lower is better
metricHints.monthlyCF: Monthly Cash Flow — total rent collected minus operating expenses and debt service
metricHints.coc: Cash-on-Cash Return — annual pre-tax cash flow divided by total cash invested
metricHints.dataPercent: Financial data completeness — how much cost and income data has been entered; higher means more accurate metrics
metricHints.wtdCapRate: Weighted Capitalization Rate — NOI divided by property value, weighted by portfolio value across all properties
metricHints.wtdCashOnCash: Weighted Cash-on-Cash Return — annual pre-tax cash flow divided by total cash invested, weighted by equity across all properties
metricHints.occupancy: Percentage of units currently occupied by contacts
metricHints.occupancyRate: Percentage of units currently rented out
metricHints.netProfit: Total income minus total expenses for the period
metricHints.hoaFee: Homeowners Association fee — shared building/complex maintenance costs
metricHints.maintenanceReserve: Annual budget set aside for unexpected repairs and upkeep
metricHints.depreciation: Tax deduction for the gradual loss of property value over time
metricHints.usefulLife: Number of years over which the property is depreciated for tax purposes
metricHints.landValue: Value of the land alone (excluded from depreciation calculations)
